                                                         // CLUMSY IS A LAG SWITCH. A LAG SWITCH IS THE TYPE OF SOFTWARE THAT DUPERS IN ONLINE GAMING USE TO DUPE ITEMS. //
													 
													                                    // HOW LAG SWITCHES ARE USED FOR DUPING //
																						
																		 // ONE WELL KNOW GAME THAT IS FILLED TO THE BRIM WITH DUPERS IS DayZ //
																		 
																// ANTI-CHEATS SUCH AS BattlEye ARE COMPLETELY INCAPABLE OF DETECTING LAG SWITCH USERS //
																			
STEP 1: 
ACTIVATE THE LAG SWITCH (CLUMSY) USING THE LEFT BRACKET KEY [. THIS IS A KEYBIND.

STEP 2: 
EXIT AND CANCEL-INITIATE EXIT, OPEN THE MENU AND SELECT "EXIT TO LOBBY" (STARTS THE COUNTDOWN TIMER).
THEN CANCEL THE TIMER, REPEAT THIS 3 TIMES (PRESS CANCEL AFTER STARTING THE LOGOUT TIMER EACH TIME DO THIS FAST).
ON THE FINAL EXIT OF THE 4TH ATTEMPT, SELECT "EXIT NOW" (PRESS IT IMMEDIATELY) THE EXIT TIMER SHOULD STILL BE 
INVISIBLE. 

STEP 3: 
WAIT IN LOBBY-STAY IN LOBBY FOR 8-10 SECONDS.
TOO SOON?- ERROR: "A USER WITH THE SAME UIID IS LAREADY IN THE SERVER."
TOO LATE?- ERROR NO CLONE WILL SPAWN.

STEP 4: 
REJOIN AND CHECK TIMER-UPON REJOINING, CHECK THE TIMER.
35-SECOND TIMER=99% SUCCESS RATE (DUPE WILL LIKELY WORK). 
15-SECOND TIMER=LESS CONSISTENT (MAY STILL WORK; IF IT FAILS, TRY REJOINING FASTER NEXT TIME).

STEP 5:
ELIMINATE YOUR CLONE-A DUPLICATED CHARACTER WILL APPEAR NEARBY.
KILL IT TO LOOT IT'S GEAR

STEP 6:
SECURE YOUR LOOT-WAIT 1-2 MINUTES AFTER KILLING THE CLONE BEFORE EXITING THE GAME. 
PREVENTS INVENTORY ROLLBACKS OR DEATHS FROM SERVER RESYNC.

ADDITIONAL TIPS:
BE LOGGED INTO THE SERVER FOR AT LEAST 30 SECONDS BEFORE ATTEMPTING TH EDUPE FOR BETTER RESULTS. 
NOT NEEDED BUT RECOMMENDED.
MULTIPLE CLONES CAN BE CREATED WITH REPEATED ATTEMPTS.

INSIDE OF THE CLUMSY FOLDER YOU WILL SEE A CONFIG FILE THAT YOU CAN RECONFIG TO THE SPECIFIC SERVER PORT THAT YOU WANT TO CONNECT TO.
FOR EXAMPLE, LETS SAY THE GAME SERVER YOU WANT TO PLAY ON USES THIS NUMBER -2305- 
ALL YOU WOULD HAVE TO DO IS PASTE THIS INTO THE CONFIG:  udp and (udp.DstPort == 2305 or udp.SrcPort == 2305)....THIS IS A COMMON PORT# FOR DayZ SERVERS.

WHEN YOU OPEN CLUMSY APP AND RUN AS ADMINISTRATOR (ALWAYS RUN AS ADMINISTRATOR) AT THE VERY TOP TOWARDS THE RIGHT YOU WILL SEE SOMETHING THAT SAYS -Presets- 
INSIDE OF -Presets- YOU WILL SEE A DROP DOWN ARROW LISTING THE PORTS YOU SAVED IN CONFIG. YOU SIMPLY CLICK THE SERVER PORT YOU WANT TO GO TO AND THAT'S IT.

INSIDE OF THE CLUMSY FOLDER IS ANOTHER IMPORTANT FILE CALLED -presets.ini-
I MENTIONED EARLIER THAT IN THIS CASE I CHOSE THE [ (BRACKET KEY) AS THE KEYBIND OR TOGGLE BUTTON THAT THEN ACTIVATES OR STARTS THE LAG SWITCH. THE [ BUTTON
CAN ALWAYS BE CHANGED TO ANOTHER KEY IF YOU LIKE. 

ALSO, -Lag_Delay = 50- AND -Drop_Chance = 99- IS THE USUAL RECOMMENDED SETTING IN -presets.ini- FOR DUPING PURPOSES.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                          // SET ASIDE FROM USING A LAG SWITCH FOR DUPING PURPOSES, THERE IS ANOTHER SETTING IN CLUMSY THAT CAN BE USED TO MAKE PLAYERS APPEAR INVISIBLE TO OTHER PLAYERS //
										  
IN THE (-Lag_Delay = - AND -Drop_Chance = -) SETTINGS, YOU CAN ADJUST LAG DELAY AND DROP CHANCE TO EFFECT DATA PACKET IN SUCH A WAY, SO THAT YOU COULD RUN PAST ANOTHER PLAYER AND APPEAR INVISIBLE TO THEM. OTHERS HAVE DONE THIS.
